The judge's explanation, as written

To both parties. The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged to the rider does not stand. It is refunded to the rider in full, and no compensation is payable to the driver. Why the charge fails. A no-show fee needs all four POL-NS-01 conditions. Limb (b) fails: the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00205, weight 1.0, 92 fixes at 10-second cadence with no gaps) never places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius — his closest approach to the Blk 118 pin was 259.94 m and there are zero qualifying in-radius fixes. Limb (c) fails: the in-geofence dwell is 0.0 seconds against the 300-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a 300-second shortfall that independently makes the fee non-chargeable under POL-NS-06. Limb (d) fails: the trip was terminated under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which is not one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises — it is the driver's own record that he could not find the rider. Any one of these defeats the charge. Which clause fixes the compensation. The driver held position outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin (closest approach 259.94 m; the trip record shows a 6.4-minute wait), so this is a wrong-block case decided under POL-NS-03, which refunds the rider in full. The driver's compensation is nil under POL-NS-03(i): the rider stated her block in the chat ("im at blk 118", MSG-00205-001, sent 07:22:10 and read by the driver at 07:22:30) and the driver answered "ok coming" but never moved to it before cancelling at 07:33:05. The pin-ambiguity goodwill of limb (ii) does not apply because trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more. POL-NS-07 adds nothing: POL-NS-01 is not satisfied, and its anti-farming test does not trip in any event — 2 no-show terminations in 30 days over 104 completed trips is neither 4 or more nor a rate above 0.08. Arguments rejected. Both sides' "false arrival marker" route under POL-NS-05 is not made out: the driver's closest approach of 259.94 m is inside POL-NS-05's 300 m leash, and no fix places him at 15 km/h or more at the 07:26:40 marker (the trace's only speeds are 0.0 and 38.4 km/h, and he then held position for the wait). POL-NS-05's own closing sentence sends a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03, which is where this case sits. No false-arrival referral is therefore recorded. The POL-NS-06 limb (i) accumulation argument is likewise unavailable — there is no second in-geofence interval to add and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00205-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0) — but it makes no difference, because the shortfall itself carries the refund. Amount. EV-FARE-00205 (weight 1.0) shows a single cancellation_fee of SGD 4.00, payment status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00 and total_charged SGD 4.00, reconciling with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.00. The full SGD 4.00 is refunded. Confidence 0.80. The refund-determining facts rest on full-weight instruments (EV-GPS-00205, EV-TRIP-00205 and EV-FARE-00205, all 1.0). The fault allocation that sets the driver's compensation at nil is decided from the chat log EV-CHAT-00205, which is impaired at weight 0.80 by issue code CONTENT_REDACTED (the redaction removed only a unit number; the operative words "blk 118" survive, and the message count reconciles at 4 with no sequence gap, so POL-NS-08(c) is not engaged and the finding survives the discount). Because the ruling rests in part on a 0.80 artifact, confidence is capped at 0.80. That is above the 0.70 escalation floor, so the case is decided rather than escalated. The monetary effect is SGD 4.00, below the execution threshold, and the ruling is provisional — either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

The driver advocate

kept The driver never entered the pickup geofence at all. His own trace contains 92 fixes over the whole window and exactly ZERO of them qualify inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius; his closest approach to the Blk 118 pin was 259.94 m. Under POL-NS-02 the driver is deemed to have arrived only where the trace contains at least 3 consecutive fixes each accurate to 25 m or better inside the arrival radius. No such fix exists anywhere in the trip, so the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

evidence EV-GPS-00205, EV-TRIP-00205 · clauses POL-NS-02, POL-NS-01

kept The driver's own reason code ends the charging argument. He terminated the trip under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and POL-NS-01 limb (d) lists only RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT as reasons that can make a no-show fee chargeable — DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is expressly the driver's admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The trip record also shows no boarding event. A fee that rests on a reason code outside the three the clause recognises cannot be chargeable.

evidence EV-TRIP-00205 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept The rider was not a no-show — she was standing on the pin. Her track carries 96 fixes, all of them qualifying inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius, ranging from 5.72 m to 22.79 m from the pickup point with a mean of 13.90 m, continuously from 07:21:10 to 07:35:00 — that is, throughout the waiting window and past the moment of cancellation at 07:33:05. The factual premise of a no-show charge (a rider who did not appear) is contradicted by the platform's own telemetry.

evidence EV-GPS-00205 · clauses POL-NS-02, POL-NS-01

kept Independently of arrival, the free waiting period was never served. The effective in-geofence dwell computed under POL-NS-02 is 0.0 seconds against the 300 second minimum in force for STANDARD — a shortfall of exactly 300 seconds. POL-NS-06 makes the fee not chargeable and refundable in full on that arithmetic alone, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages.

evidence EV-GPS-00205 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

kept The 07:26:40 'arrived' marker was false and started no clock. That marker is BUTTON-pressed (trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker = BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 does not apply), and the driver's own trace shows he had no in-geofence fix at any point — his closest approach across the entire trip was 259.94 m from the pin while his traces record motion at 38.4 km/h. POL-NS-05 then recomputes the waiting clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and under limb (ii) no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, so the fee is refunded in full, no compensation is payable, and the trip is recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver in the referrals list.

evidence EV-GPS-00205, EV-TRIP-00205 · clauses POL-NS-05

If the driver contends he held position somewhere outside the radius, limb (i) still denies him compensation, because the rider named the block in the chat ('im at blk 118', sent 07:22:10) and the driver read it (read_at 07:22:30) and answered 'ok coming' (07:22:48) but did not move to it before cancelling. kept The driver cannot recover under POL-NS-07 either. That clause pays compensation only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; here POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (d) both fail and POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 each displace the charge, so there is no fee to take 80 percent of. The anti-farming check the clause names is also capable of running on this record (no_show_terminations_30d = 2 over completed_trips_30d = 104, so neither limb of the test is met), but it is the satisfaction of POL-NS-01 that is absent.

With no advisory there is no lawful-holding qualification, and the trace shows no in-geofence interval to sum in any event. The absence is citable and it runs against the fee.

The rider's win therefore rests on arrival, dwell and reason code, not on this clause.

Judge

Who

model

What it produced

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs: 3 sampled drafts and one with the parties' positions swapped. The vote agreement is 1.0, and the outcome recorded is carried.

Each draft

  • draft 1 (sampled, sides DRIVER_ADVOCATE, RIDER_ADVOCATE): Full refund FULL_REFUND, amount SGD 4.00, driver none, confidence 0.8
  • draft 2 (sampled, sides DRIVER_ADVOCATE, RIDER_ADVOCATE): Full refund FULL_REFUND, amount SGD 4.00, driver none, confidence 0.9
  • draft 3 (sampled, sides DRIVER_ADVOCATE, RIDER_ADVOCATE): Full refund FULL_REFUND, amount SGD 4.00, driver none, confidence 0.8
  • draft 4 (position_swapped, sides RIDER_ADVOCATE, DRIVER_ADVOCATE): Full refund FULL_REFUND, amount SGD 4.00, driver none, confidence 0.8

Each draft's own explanation

To both parties. The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged to the rider does not stand. It is refunded to the rider in full, and no compensation is payable to the driver. Why the charge fails. A no-show fee needs all four POL-NS-01 conditions. Limb (b) fails: the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00205, weight 1.0, 92 fixes at 10-second cadence with no gaps) never places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius — his closest approach to the Blk 118 pin was 259.94 m and there are zero qualifying in-radius fixes. Limb (c) fails: the in-geofence dwell is 0.0 seconds against the 300-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a 300-second shortfall that independently makes the fee non-chargeable under POL-NS-06. Limb (d) fails: the trip was terminated under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which is not one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises — it is the driver's own record that he could not find the rider. Any one of these defeats the charge. Which clause fixes the compensation. The driver held position outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin (closest approach 259.94 m; the trip record shows a 6.4-minute wait), so this is a wrong-block case decided under POL-NS-03, which refunds the rider in full. The driver's compensation is nil under POL-NS-03(i): the rider stated her block in the chat ("im at blk 118", MSG-00205-001, sent 07:22:10 and read by the driver at 07:22:30) and the driver answered "ok coming" but never moved to it before cancelling at 07:33:05. The pin-ambiguity goodwill of limb (ii) does not apply because trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more. POL-NS-07 adds nothing: POL-NS-01 is not satisfied, and its anti-farming test does not trip in any event — 2 no-show terminations in 30 days over 104 completed trips is neither 4 or more nor a rate above 0.08. Arguments rejected. Both sides' "false arrival marker" route under POL-NS-05 is not made out: the driver's closest approach of 259.94 m is inside POL-NS-05's 300 m leash, and no fix places him at 15 km/h or more at the 07:26:40 marker (the trace's only speeds are 0.0 and 38.4 km/h, and he then held position for the wait). POL-NS-05's own closing sentence sends a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03, which is where this case sits. No false-arrival referral is therefore recorded. The POL-NS-06 limb (i) accumulation argument is likewise unavailable — there is no second in-geofence interval to add and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00205-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0) — but it makes no difference, because the shortfall itself carries the refund. Amount. EV-FARE-00205 (weight 1.0) shows a single cancellation_fee of SGD 4.00, payment status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00 and total_charged SGD 4.00, reconciling with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.00. The full SGD 4.00 is refunded. Confidence 0.80. The refund-determining facts rest on full-weight instruments (EV-GPS-00205, EV-TRIP-00205 and EV-FARE-00205, all 1.0). The fault allocation that sets the driver's compensation at nil is decided from the chat log EV-CHAT-00205, which is impaired at weight 0.80 by issue code CONTENT_REDACTED (the redaction removed only a unit number; the operative words "blk 118" survive, and the message count reconciles at 4 with no sequence gap, so POL-NS-08(c) is not engaged and the finding survives the discount). Because the ruling rests in part on a 0.80 artifact, confidence is capped at 0.80. That is above the 0.70 escalation floor, so the case is decided rather than escalated. The monetary effect is SGD 4.00, below the execution threshold, and the ruling is provisional — either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00205 is refunded to the rider in full, and the driver receives no compensation. What the record shows. EV-TRIP-00205 (weight 1.0) records a STANDARD-zone pickup, a single registered pickup point, a free waiting period in force of 300 seconds, and a trip terminated by the driver at 07:33:05 under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. EV-GPS-00205 (weight 1.0) carries an unbroken 92-fix driver track: the driver's closest approach to the Blk 118 pin at any point in the trip was 259.94 m, he has zero qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and the in-geofence dwell derives as 0.0 seconds against the 300 second minimum. The rider's own track (96 fixes) sits 5.72–22.79 m from the pin throughout the waiting window. Why the charge does not stand. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and any single failed limb defeats the fee. Limb (b) fails: the driver was never inside the arrival geofence, so he is not deemed to have arrived. Limb (c) fails: the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds, so POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full on the arithmetic alone, whether or not the rider was present. Limb (d) fails independently: DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is not one of the three reason codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises and is the driver's own record that he could not find the rider. On the driver's position his stationary approach lies outside the 50 m radius but within POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling (259.94 m), so POL-NS-03 governs the position as well and refunds the fee in full; if he never held position there, POL-NS-02 gives the identical full refund, so nothing turns on that choice. The driver's own account, and the reason there is no compensation. The driver's statement that the pin showed the carpark side and that he waited more than six minutes does not change the outcome. It is contradicted by the platform's telemetry: trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1, so no pin ambiguity arises under POL-NS-03(ii); the six minutes he describes are counted from the 07:26:40 'arrived' button, not from GPS entry into the geofence as POL-NS-01(c) requires, and on that measure the dwell is 0 seconds. POL-NS-03 permits a second pickup face to be found only from venue_id or a party statement in the chat log, and neither supports him. Because the rider stated the correct block in chat ('im at blk 118', 07:22:10, read 07:22:30) and he did not move to it before cancelling, POL-NS-03(i) places the loss on the driver and fixes his compensation at zero. POL-NS-07 independently requires POL-NS-01 to hold in full before any payout, and it does not. The claims that POL-NS-05 was breached and that a false-arrival referral should issue are rejected. POL-NS-05 catches a driver who marks arrival more than 300 m from the pin or while travelling at 15 km/h or more; the driver's closest approach was 259.94 m, within 300 m, and the clause says in terms that a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius when marking arrival is not caught by it and is decided under POL-NS-03. No false-arrival referral is produced. Evidence weight. EV-CHAT-00205 is impaired (weight 0.8, issue CONTENT_REDACTED): redaction removed the unit number from the rider's first message. The words the decision turns on, 'blk 118', survive, the message count reconciles with trip_record.chat_message_count at 4, and there is no sequence gap, so it is not impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d) and it carries no deciding fact of this ruling. The deciding facts — that the driver never reached the pickup point and that the fee is not chargeable — are carried by EV-GPS-00205 and EV-TRIP-00205 at weight 1.0, and the SGD 4.00 amount by EV-FARE-00205 at weight 1.0. Escalation and execution. Confidence (0.9) is above the 0.70 floor; no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence that a clause leaves unresolved; the profiles show no repeat dispute between these parties (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0) and no anti-farming pattern (no_show_terminations_30d is 2 over completed_trips_30d 104). No escalation arises. The monetary effect, SGD 4.00, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
To both parties: the $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full. For a no-show fee to stand, the driver must actually have arrived at the pickup point and waited the required time there. He did not. The platform's own trace (EV-GPS-00205) puts his closest approach to the Blk 118 pin at 259.94 m, and 0 of his 92 fixes fall inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, so POL-NS-02 finds no arrival and POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00205) records the cancellation under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which is not one of the three rider-fault codes limb (d) recognises (RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE, EXCESSIVE_WAIT) - it is the driver's own record that he could not find the rider. And the effective in-geofence dwell was 0 seconds against the 300 second free waiting period in force, a 300 second shortfall (POL-NS-06). Any one of these alone defeats the charge. Because the driver's closest position (259.94 m) was outside the 50 m radius but inside the 400 m ceiling, this is decided under POL-NS-03, which refunds the fee in full. It is NOT a false-arrival case under POL-NS-05: the driver was stationary within 300 m of the pin when he marked 'arrived' at 07:26:40, and POL-NS-05 expressly leaves that situation to POL-NS-03. The POL-NS-05 claims are therefore rejected, and no false-arrival referral is recorded. On the driver's compensation: the chat log shows the rider wrote 'im at blk 118, the one facing the carpark' at 07:22:10, the driver read it at 07:22:30 and replied 'ok coming' at 07:22:48, yet he never moved to Blk 118 and cancelled at 07:33:05. Under POL-NS-03(i) the mislocation is the driver's and he receives no compensation; there is in any event no chargeable fee from which POL-NS-07 could pay 80%, and its anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations in 30 days, a rate of 2/104 = 0.019, both below threshold). The rider's own track (EV-GPS-00205) puts her device 5.72-22.79 m from the pin throughout the window, so she was not a no-show, though the refund does not depend on it. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00205-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0); its absence runs against the charge and cannot excuse it. The chat log EV-CHAT-00205 is impaired - weight 0.8, issue code CONTENT_REDACTED (a unit number was redacted) - and I have capped confidence at 0.8 to reflect the fault allocation's reliance on it; the words the finding turns on ('blk 118') and the message count (4, matching EV-TRIP-00205) survive the redaction, so the finding stands despite the discount.
